'''House Kassido''' was one of seventeen [[Noble/Legends|noble]] houses that settled in the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region after the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] implemented the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. House Kassido based itself in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], where it controlled the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Kassido]] and [[Ossiathora]]. The Kassido nobles became very rich as a result of trade with [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]] and in the direction of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], although their dealings with outsiders led many within Senex-Juvex to hold little esteem for House Kassido. The [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Karduran]]s were a client [[Species/Legends|species]] of House Kassido.
